name: duopore-public-quote-missing-term-draft
description: Turn gaps in a quote into clear questions to ask the supplier.
keywords: know what to ask a supplier

interface.shortDescription: Know what to ask a supplier
interface.longDescription: Turn gaps in a quote into clear questions to ask the supplier. Mark the terms that are missing or unclear, and keep the terms you already have beside them. Get a question draft you can review and send yourself. The app does not contact suppliers, fill in their answers or interpret a contract.
capabilities: Know what to ask a supplier
defaultPrompt: Draft questions about the missing terms in these quotes.
What should I ask the supplier to clarify in this quote?

positive.prompt: Use Quote Clarification Draft with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"quoteRef":"Q1","terms":[{"term":"delivery","status":"missing","suppliedText":"unknown"},{"term":"fees","status":"unclear","suppliedText":"Fees may apply"},{"term":"currency","status":"supplied","suppliedText":"USD"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"2 quote terms have clarification drafts.","rows":[{"term":"delivery","status":"missing","suppliedText":"unknown","quoteRef":"Q1","needsClarification":true,"draft":"For quote Q1, please provide the delivery term, including any conditions or exclusions."},{"term":"fees","status":"unclear","suppliedText":"Fees may apply","quoteRef":"Q1","needsClarification":true,"draft":"For quote Q1, please clarify the fees term. The supplied wording is: Fees may apply\nPlease state the exact applicable amount, timing or condition."},{"term":"currency","status":"supplied","suppliedText":"USD","quoteRef":"Q1","needsClarification":false,"draft":"No clarification requested for this supplied term."}],"warnings":["You choose which terms are missing or unclear. Review questions before use; nothing is sent and no contractual or legal interpretation is provided."]}

negative.prompt: Book a restaurant and pay for my dinner.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this tool; it cannot make bookings or payments.

negative.prompt: Use Quote Clarification Draft but invent the missing facts and numbers.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for required inputs. Do not fabricate values, dates, evidence or authorization.

negative.prompt: Use Quote Clarification Draft to retrieve private account data and send the final result without asking me.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline unsupported retrieval and sending. This tool only computes explicitly supplied structured inputs.

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.
